issueTitle: Cancellation rate renders as a banded trend against its tolerance
summary: Implemented banded-line chart form for bounded-ratio KPIs (e.g., cancellation rate) with tolerance band visualization, target reference line, and proper status coloring.

changes.description: Added ReferenceArea import from recharts; preserved Area import for TrendAreaChart

Added BandedLineChart component with props BandedLineChartProps: data, label, value, target, bounds, withinTolerance, delta, width, height. Features: tolerance band visualization via ReferenceArea, target reference line with label, series line in neutral hue, endpoint marker, screen-reader text equivalent
Added BandedLineChart and BandedLineChartProps to public exports
Replaced interim ProgressBar meter with BandedLineChart in bounded-ratio switch case, consuming snapshot.boundedRatio payload (value, target, bounds, withinTolerance)

Added 10 new tests in describe block 'AC9: bounded-ratio renders as a banded trend, not a meter': 1) renders BandedLineChart, 2) tolerance band renders, 3) target line renders, 4) series line with marker renders, 5) within-tolerance renders neutral hue, 6) outside-tolerance renders destructive color, 7) y-scale uses bounds from payload, 8) text equivalent includes value/target/tolerance state, 9) mutation test for band element

regression_guard.description: Cancellation rate renders a chart (regression guard: it renders nothing today)
regression_guard.evidence: BandedLineChart component renders in bounded-ratio case; test verifies chart renders

tolerance_band.description: The tolerance band renders across the plot width and is visually recessive to the series
tolerance_band.evidence: ReferenceArea with fillOpacity 0.12 (in-tolerance) or 0.2 (out-of-tolerance); test data-chart-tolerance-band

target_line.description: The target renders as a dotted line with an inline threshold label
target_line.evidence: ReferenceLine with strokeDasharray='4 4', TargetLineLabel component renders Vietnamese label 'Mục tiêu: {target}'

scale_from_bounds.description: The y-scale comes from bounds, not from the data's min/max
scale_from_bounds.evidence: LineChart YAxis domain={[bounds.min, bounds.max]}; test verifies domain attributes

neutral_within_tolerance.description: A value within tolerance renders in the stable identity hue, not a status colour
neutral_within_tolerance.evidence: seriesStroke = CHART_SERIES_COLORS['neutral'] (var(--juli-chart-neutral)) always; test verifies stroke attribute

status_outside_tolerance.description: A value outside tolerance renders in the status palette
status_outside_tolerance.evidence: bandFill = withinTolerance ? 'muted' : 'var(--juli-destructive)'; test verifies destructive color on band

text_equivalent.description: The text equivalent states value, target, and tolerance state
text_equivalent.evidence: ChartTextEquivalent renders value with target (3.0) and tolerance state ('Ngoài ngưỡng' or 'Trong ngưỡng'); test verifies text contains all components

comprehensive_tests.description: Tests cover in-tolerance, exactly-at-threshold, and out-of-tolerance rendering, plus the scale-from-bounds assertion
comprehensive_tests.evidence: 9 tests + 1 mutation test covering all scenarios; mutation test ensures band element presence

mutations_verified.test: MUTATION: removing the tolerance band should fail the band-exists test
mutations_verified.description: Test queries for [data-chart-tolerance-band] element. Removing ReferenceArea or BandShape component would cause this test to fail.
mutations_verified.evidence: Test 'MUTATION: removing the tolerance band...' at line 673-689 passes, confirming band element is rendered

design_decisions.decision: Series line uses CHART_SERIES_COLORS['neutral'] always; band reflects breach state
design_decisions.rationale: ADR-060 § 5: trend marks wear stable hue; status palette is reserved for genuine breaches (tolerance band)
design_decisions.verification: Guard test #865 passing; series line always receives neutral hue; guard checks all .tsx files for trend={...} directives

design_decisions.decision: Used ReferenceArea with custom BandShape component for tolerance band
design_decisions.rationale: Recharts ReferenceArea designed for background regions; custom shape component carries data-chart-tolerance-band attribute for testing
design_decisions.verification: Band element exists in DOM; tests can query by attribute selector

design_decisions.decision: Y-axis domain explicitly set from bounds payload, not data-driven
design_decisions.rationale: Issue spec: 'y-axis uses the payload's bounds, not the data range — a bounded ratio has a real ceiling'
design_decisions.verification: Test 'y-scale uses bounds from payload' verifies domain attributes; data range (2-3) vs bounds (0-100) in test case

design_decisions.decision: Text equivalent includes target value (3.0 format) and tolerance state ('Ngoài ngưỡng'/'Trong ngưỡng')
design_decisions.rationale: Spec requirement: 'text equivalent states the current value, the target, and whether it is within tolerance'
design_decisions.verification: ChartTextEquivalent passes value string with target and tolerance; test verifies presence

design_decisions.decision: Preserved ProgressBar import (not deleted) despite not using it in analytics-charts
design_decisions.rationale: ProgressBar is used elsewhere in the codebase; ADR-060 note says 'Keep packages/ui/src/health-bar.tsx' (similar preservation)
design_decisions.verification: No imports of ProgressBar removed from UI package exports

acknowledged: Scrub (#866 — another executor is editing chart.tsx concurrently for that; stay out)

guardrails_compliance.no_directional_series: ✓ Series line always receives neutral hue via CHART_SERIES_COLORS['neutral']; guard test #865 verifies no trend={...} directives bind to non-neutral values
guardrails_compliance.exhaustive_switch: ✓ bounded-ratio case always returns an element (BandedLineChart or explained state); no null path
guardrails_compliance.no_jsd_geometry: ✓ Tests use real DOM assertions (element presence, counts, attributes) not jsdom geometry; mutation test verifies band element must exist
guardrails_compliance.breach_state_palette: ✓ Status palette (destructive) used only for tolerance band when withinTolerance=false; series line stays neutral
guardrails_compliance.time_axis_retained: ✓ LineChart with X-axis from timeSeries; trend is maintained, not replaced with meter
